summary: Added an interactive DFM guide with in-page component markers and concise contextual help across all tabs.
details: Use the compact circular help button to toggle component outlines; hover components or focus numbered markers for one short tooltip at a time.
Hints explain double-click ratio charts, component-specific right-click menus, curve editing, chart interactions and keyboard shortcuts.
The guide keeps the full working page width, with no side panel, and does not change the method or its save state.
